jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

This is a single-customer Deployment Strategist role dedicated to a large government contract. Reporting into Customer Success, you'll be the embedded partner accountable for the customer’s success on TRM's AI investigation platform — owning adoption, value realization, and the trajectory of the account over a multi-year horizon, and coordinating the 25+ TRM personnel deployed onsite to make sure outcomes are achieved.

Early on, the work is equal parts standing up value and architecting the program: onboarding users, running trainings, and capturing wins so the customer feels TRM's impact from day one — while also defining the operating model, cadences, metrics, and the roadmap for how the account matures. As it does, more day-to-day execution shifts to the customer's own team and you move into the full steady-state DS remit — sustained adoption, reporting, business reviews, and the partnership that underpins renewal and expansion.

What you'll own

Account success & value realization — you own the outcome: adoption, mission impact, and the value story that carries renewal and expansion.
Program architecture & governance — define the operating model, cadences, decision rights, and escalation paths; own the program charter and keep it current.
Onsite team coordination — coordinate across the 25+ TRM personnel deployed onsite, keeping the embedded team aligned and driving toward the outcomes the customer is counting on.
Metric design & tracking — determine what gets measured (mission outcomes, platform usage, capability maturity), wire up the dashboards, and own the story the numbers tell — reported both internally and to the customer.
Workload & transition strategy — author and drive the roadmap for shifting workflows from TRM-led to customer-led, deciding which move, on what timeline, and under what conditions, evolving the model from TRM-heavy to partnership to advisory.
Adoption & enablement — onboard new platform users, field customer questions, and make sure users reach their first meaningful outcomes ("magic moments").
Training & readiness — host platform trainings for HQ and field, and partner with TRM Academy so readiness gates are met before users take on live work.
Value capture & communication — capture and record wins, communicate that value back through the regular drumbeat (standups, MBRs, QBRs), and translate program outcomes into the option-year and expansion narrative (the data backbone, not the deal-owner).
Cross-functional coordination — act as the connective tissue across TRM — investigations, TRM Academy, Product/Engineering, and Capture/RevOps — keeping everyone aligned and unblocked.
Customer deliverables & sprint coordination — help the customer produce the administrative deliverables they need and support their sprint coordination.
Risk & issue management — maintain the risk log, flag threats to milestones, and drive mitigations.

What success looks like

Year 1: The operating model, governance, and reporting are stood up; users are onboarded and active; trainings are running for HQ and field; and you're consistently capturing wins and communicating that value back — TRM's impact is visible and documented, and a deliberate shift of routine work toward the customer's team has begun.
Year 2 and beyond: The account is in steady state on the full DS remit — sustained adoption, usage reporting, business reviews, deliverable support — with the customer owning more day-to-day execution and TRM's value clear enough to carry renewal and expansion.

What we're looking for

Program management experience — you can own operating cadences, a multi-stakeholder roadmap, and cross-functional coordination without formal authority, not just track a schedule.
Experience in customer success, deployment, or a strategist/CSM-type role, ideally embedded with a single strategic account.
Experience running QBRs/MBRs and managing revenue outcomes (adoption, renewal, expansion).
Background in or alongside threat intelligence, scam disruption, cyber disruption, or critical infrastructure — you understand the mission and the stakeholders.
Experience delivering in or alongside government / public sector environments.
Strong facilitation and communication skills — comfortable training both leadership and field users and translating usage and outcomes into a clear value story.
AI fluency — you use AI tools to work faster and sharper, and can reason about how an AI investigation platform changes analyst workflows and where human judgment stays essential, helping non-technical users build trust in AI-assisted outputs.

Nice to have

Familiarity with blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, or financial-crime workflows.
Experience supporting federal law enforcement or national security customers.

About The Team

You'll join TRM's Customer Success / Deployment Strategist function as the dedicated owner of a large, single-customer government deployment.
This is a net-new seat: you both stand up the program and architect how it matures, with high autonomy and high ownership.
You'll coordinate a large embedded TRM team onsite and partner across TRM Academy, Product/Engineering, and Capture/RevOps.
The bar is high: every DS is expected to pair program-ownership depth with the customer judgment to operate with ownership in a sensitive environment.

Team Operating Rhythms

Distributed, not distant. The team is US-based, with regular onsite presence in the DC metro area (up to 3 days per week).
Synchronous onsite with the customer and the embedded team; asynchronous between engagements in Slack and Notion.
Weekly 1:1 with manager and a weekly program-health sync; a regular MBR/QBR cadence with the customer.
Operates in US business hours with overlap for internal syncs.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

Schedule: US business hours, with overlap across TRM teams for internal syncs and coverage of the customer's operating hours.

On-Call Responsibilities

This role has no on-call responsibilities

Travel Requirements

Schedule: Hybrid onsite at the customer in the DC metro area; periodic travel to other sites as the mission requires.
Frequency: Up to 3 days a week onsite

Onsite Requirements

Schedule: Regular in-person presence at the customer site to coordinate the embedded team and run working sessions and trainings.
Frequency: Up to 3 days a week onsite

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

Within 30 days: map the deployment, meet the embedded team and key customer stakeholders, and stand up the first automated weekly readout so value is visible from the start.
Within 60 days: launch the operating cadence (standups, reporting, risk log) and onboard the first wave of users to their first meaningful outcomes, with trainings running for HQ and field.
Within 90 days: deliver the first customer MBR/QBR with a coherent metric story and captured wins, and publish the transition roadmap for shifting routine work toward the customer's team.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only
The estimated base salary range for this role is $127,000-$156,000.
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Title

Senior Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security. 

Why Join Us? 

Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions. 
Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace. 
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense. 

 Position Summary

KBR is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Information Technology Operations Manager to support the Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Command, Control, Communications and Battle Management.  The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in operating and maintaining information technology systems in a government facility at security levels ranging from Unclassified up to and including Top Secret with Special Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) accesses required.

You will be responsible for maintaining the IT infrastructure used by the PAE’s Pentagon office to collaborate across the PAE and its stakeholders while also assisting with IT infrastructure at the PAE’s other National Capital Region offices.  The ideal candidate should be just as comfortable managing IT projects as they are with installing any required IT capabilities.

Key Responsibilities: 

Serves as the primary interface with government NCR IT support organizations and the PAE to install and operate NIPRNet, SIPRNet and AFSCI voice, video, and computing capabilities within the PAE’s Pentagon office while assisting with other offices throughout the NCR
Serves as the primary interface to DAF SAP enterprise IT providers to enable SAP voice (SVS), video (AF7), and computing capabilities (CV2 and PLx) within the PAE’s Pentagon office while assisting with other offices throughout the NCR

Location: Pentagon (with local travel throughout the NCR as required)

Working Hours: Standard – Core hours 0900 – 1500 

Qualifications: 

  Required: 

Education & Experience: 
Minimum of 10 years of experience operating IT systems in a government facility

Technical Expertise: 
Demonstrated ability to install, operate and maintain SAP IT systems
Experience with cloud-based solutions in an Air Force or DoD context (e.g., AWS, Azure). 
Experience with office collaboration tools such as Microsoft Office, Project and Visio
Demonstrated ability to work well independently or as a team member. 
Demonstrated ability to drive projects to closure and to assimilate and correlate project information in a fast-paced environment. 
Ability to obtain Information System Security Officer (ISSO) and/or Information system Security Manager (ISSM) appointment(s)

Communication and Collaboration: 
Proven ability to lead projects

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex IT concepts to program leaders
Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Ability to navigate the complexities of military contracting processes and collaborate with others to procure and install IT systems

Active TS clearance w/ SCI eligibility and prior SAP experience  

Desired:

Bachelor's Degree in IT or Cybersecurity 
Information Assurance, Cybersecurity, or Information Security experience supporting federal or DoD environments

Required: CompTIA Sec+

$160,000-$200,000

Business Readiness Project Manager

Location:
All UK sites considered with national travel. We offer a range of hybrid and flexible working arrangements – please speak to your recruiter about the options for this particular role.

Salary:
Circa £65000 depending on experience

Who We Are

Join BAE Systems and you’ll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you’ll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You’ll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow, shaping a safer future, for all of us.

From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space, there’s no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you.

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Readiness Project Manager to support the successful delivery of a major finance transformation programme. Working across multiple business areas, you will lead business readiness activities to ensure teams, processes and stakeholders are prepared for change, supporting the adoption and embedding of new technology and ways of working. This role requires solid project management experience, excellent stakeholder engagement and a proven track record of delivering complex business change initiatives.

Core Duties

Lead and manage business readiness activities for assigned business areas, working closely with programme and business stakeholders
Create, maintain and track business readiness plans, ensuring key activities are delivered to agreed timelines
Monitor risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, driving actions to support successful delivery
Ensure alignment with programme governance, methodologies, controls and reporting requirements
Develop and maintain detailed workstream plans, aligned to the overall programme plan and milestones
Work with business leaders to secure resources, manage priorities and resolve delivery challenges
Collaborate with programme teams and workstreams to identify and manage cross-functional dependencies
Facilitate regular readiness, planning and status meetings, providing clear progress updates to stakeholders
Capture lessons learned, continuous improvement opportunities and best practice to support future programme delivery

Essential Skills

Proven project management experience delivering large-scale business transformation or change programmes
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams from initiation through to implementation and closure
Knowledge of project governance, planning, risk management and PMO methodologies
Experience using project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, Visio and Excel
Good understanding of project delivery approaches including Waterfall, Agile and hybrid methodologies

The Team

You will join the Ad Astra programme, a business-led transformation delivering significant change across the finance function. Working alongside Business Deployment Leads, Change Managers and programme teams, the team is responsible for ensuring business areas are fully prepared to adopt new processes, data, reporting and technology solutions. This is a highly collaborative environment where you will work closely with stakeholders across the organisation, helping to drive the successful implementation of major change and supporting BAE Systems ambition to build a world-class finance function.

Why BAE Systems?

Here you’ll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work, this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. You’ll be recognised for your contribution and enjoy rewards tailored to what’s most important to you and your family, support for your financial and personal wellbeing, as well as a balanced lifestyle. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make.

A Place Where Everyone Can Thrive

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do.

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.

Closing Date:
15th October 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Muon seeks an Avionics Technical Program Manager to lead the end-to-end planning, production, acceptance testing, and delivery of flight electronic assemblies for our next-generation satellite constellations. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of electrical engineering, hardware manufacturing, flight software, and Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T).

The Avionics TPM will serve as the primary operational owner for transforming engineered printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) into complete, tested units ready for spacecraft integration and software development testbeds. The role spans hardware development, supply chain coordination, unit testing execution, and fleet-scale delivery across multiple concurrent missions.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Please note: This role will need full time on-site (5x/week) for the first six months for a ramp up period and then can transition to hybrid schedule (3x/week)

Responsibilities

Hardware Delivery
Avionics Unit Delivery: Own the complete delivery pipeline and schedule for fully tested, flight-ready PCBA units to AI&T for spacecraft vehicle integration.
Testbed Fleet Support: Deliver complete, validated PCBA units to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) testbeds to support ongoing Flight Software (FSW) development, verification, and mission simulations.

Unit Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Qualification
UAT Execution: Drive the planning, resource allocation, and schedule execution of Unit Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all flight avionics entering AI&T.
Program Metrics & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report UAT performance metrics—including schedule variance, test bed readiness, yield rates, technical performance, and risk posture.

Cross-Functional Execution & Release Planning
Release Timeline Planning: Partner with engineering teams to establish, maintain, and execute PCBA release timelines across current and future satellite constellation blocks.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive end-to-end execution across cross-functional teams spanning EE design, PCBA fabrication, assembly, functional testing, and vehicle AI&T.

Supply Chain & Risk Management
Procurement Tracking: Track procurement, long-lead component acquisition, and assembly status for all custom PCBAs and associated mechanical enclosures/mounting hardware.
Issue Resolution: Proactively identify, track, and drive resolution of supply chain bottlenecks, component obsolescence, component lead time spikes, and test fallout issues.

Required Qualifications

1. Leadership & Systems Management

Design, manage, and continually improve workflows for Facilities, IT, and Operations requests.
Establish and maintain SOPs, policies, operational checklists, and approval workflows in consultation with the Operations Director.
Monitor organizational bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve efficiency.
Ensure departments follow operational processes and maintain accountability.

Oversee site readiness across all Rafiki locations, including maintenance planning, safety compliance, and equipment tracking.
Coordinate multi-site maintenance priorities and monitor progress on repairs and upgrades.
Anticipate operational risks and proactively resolve issues.

Oversee rental revenue tracking, invoicing workflows, and outstanding balance follow-up.
Maintain quality assurance to ensure renters receive a consistent, professional experience.

Lead operations planning for major community events, partnerships, and multi-site programs.
Build operational timelines, checklists, staffing plans, and cross-department communication structures.
Direct the onsite operations team during events and coordinate with Facilities, IT, Programs, and Finance.

Directly supervise and support the Operations Coordinator and Facilities Coordinator.
Set priorities, delegate tasks, and ensure execution across operational functions.
Assign tasks, set priorities, and ensure high-quality execution.
Conduct regular check-ins, provide feedback, coaching, and support professional development support.
Ensure coordinated coverage across sites and operational needs.

Support leadership in long-term planning, including capital improvements, space planning, and system upgrades.
Provide recommendations to leadership on operational risks, opportunities, and resource needs.
Prepare operational reporting, tracking metrics, and documenting improvements.

ROLE CHARACTERISTICS

Leads operational decision-making.
Creates systems; does not just execute them.
Supervises staff and manages workload across sites.
Oversees external vendors, contractors, and property managers.
Manages budgets, contracts, and operational priorities.
Acts as a strategic partner to leadership during planning.
Strong relationship manager

new_jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As a Lead Technical Program Manager within the Global Customer Support & Digital Experience organization, you will own the end-to-end program management discipline for a defined portfolio of high-impact programs, translating department priorities into structured plans, integrated schedules, and measurable outcomes. This role drives meaningful organizational impact by modernizing how the support function plans, executes, and measures complex initiatives while improving visibility into cross-functional risks and dependencies. You will serve as a high-leverage delivery leader who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and elevates the delivery capability of every team you partner with.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Technical Program Manager.

Responsibility

Support the integration of Support & Digital Experience planning and program execution with corporate planning standards to eliminate planning lag across the organization
Partner with Support, Product, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Operations stakeholders to scope, sequence, and execute high-priority programs with clear ownership, decision points, dependencies, and success measures
Maintain an integrated program-level view for assigned initiatives to provide leadership with reliable and on-time visibility into scope, progress, risks, decisions, and business outcomes
Drive the end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional Support & Digital Experience programs, ensuring that workstreams stay aligned to agreed scope, delivery timelines, and technical dependencies
Apply and improve program management standards, ensuring that business requirements, stakeholder commitments, success measures, and guardrails are clearly defined, documented, and actively managed
Own integrated schedules, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and escalation paths for assigned programs to proactively surface and resolve blockers
Design reusable program frameworks, templates, and playbooks for assigned initiative types that reduce setup time and improve consistency across future programs
Lead program retrospectives and operational reviews that capture lessons learned, identify reusable practices, and improve the quality, speed, and predictability of execution
Build and maintain program health dashboards, reporting views, and metrics that give stakeholders actionable visibility into execution status and KR progress
Mentor and develop less experienced program managers by sharing frameworks, reviewing program plans, and modeling strong program management practices
Run effective operating cadences for assigned programs, including working team forums, leadership reviews, risk reviews, and launch readiness checkpoints
Lead through influence rather than authority, driving alignment and accountability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship
Contribute to monthly and quarterly business review materials by synthesizing program status, risks, and forward-looking priorities into concise, leadership-ready narratives
Represent assigned Support & Digital Experience programs in cross-functional planning and execution forums to ensure operational impacts are understood and addressed
Lead defined transformation initiatives that improve support systems, customer self-service, technical support engineer workflows, and operational execution maturity
Apply organizational change management principles to sustain adoption of new systems, processes, and ways of working across affected teams
Anticipate industry disruptions driven by AI, and leverage AI trends to enhance functional strategy and long-term operational excellence
Partner with AI, automation, product, engineering, and operations teams to identify and execute practical opportunities to reduce repetitive manual work, improve precision, and increase self-service effectiveness
Apply lean and continuous improvement principles to assigned programs, helping teams eliminate waste, clarify ownership, and improve handoffs
Use internal data, stakeholder feedback, customer pain points, and industry practices to recommend improvements, shape program priorities, and support investment decisions

Job Designation

Remote:
Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office,

Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

12+ years of experience in technical program management, support operations, professional services, product operations, or engineering program management, with 5+ years leading cross-functional technical programs
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or an equivalent combination of technical degree and experience)
Experience managing programs with multiple workstreams, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder engagement
Experience with SaaS platforms, data flows, integrations, APIs, internal tooling, customer support systems, and automation workflows
Experience with program and portfolio management tools including Jira, Confluence, Asana, Smartsheet, or ServiceNow PPM
Experience synthesizing program details into narratives, status updates, and decision paths for leadership audiences
Experience building program health dashboards, defining success metrics, and using data for risk management
Experience developing business cases or investment justifications, including articulating expected ROI and resource requirements

Preferred

Experience applying lean, Agile, or scaled delivery methodologies to improve execution maturity and reduce operational waste
Experience driving organizational change management for programs involving new systems, processes, or operating models
Familiarity with AI/ML-driven support tools, digital experience platforms, customer self-service automation, generative AI concepts, or LLM-enabled workflows
Experience contributing to portfolio governance, business review cadences, or enterprise planning frameworks
Professional certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, or Lean Six Sigma
Experience with Salesforce, customer support platforms, BI/reporting tools, SQL, or Tableau
Experience mentoring program managers or building and sharing reusable delivery frameworks and playbooks.

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Core Banking Transformation programme, one of the most strategic initiatives within the organization.

Our mission is to modernize the banking landscape by migrating products, customer journeys, and operational processes from legacy platforms to a future-ready core banking environment. This is a complex transformation that sits at the heart of the business and requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and delivery expertise.

As Project Manager, you will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of migration initiatives, ensuring teams remain aligned, risks are proactively managed, and key milestones are achieved. You will work closely with business leaders, product teams, architects, engineers, operations, and external partners to deliver meaningful change for both customers and the organization.

We are also embracing AI-enabled ways of working and are looking for someone who is excited about leveraging AI to improve delivery, accelerate decision-making, and simplify complex processes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead large-scale core banking migration projects from initiation through go-live and stabilization.
Coordinate business, technology, operations, testing, and migration activities across multiple teams.
Manage project plans, dependencies, budgets, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Drive governance, reporting, and decision-making at program and senior management level.
Ensure delivery complies with regulatory, security, risk, and audit requirements.
Support the adoption of AI-enabled delivery practices across the programme.
Contribute to the successful migration and decommissioning of legacy banking platforms.

About The Team

You will become part of a highly ambitious transformation programme that combines deep banking expertise with modern technology. The team consists of business specialists, product leads, architects, engineers, operations experts, and transformation professionals who work together towards a shared goal: building the next generation of core banking capabilities. The environment is dynamic, collaborative, and fast-paced. Success depends on strong partnerships, clear communication, and a hands-on approach to delivery.

You will be part of the Tribe Business Lending.

What You Bring

We are looking for a delivery-focused project manager who thrives in complex environments and enjoys bringing people together to achieve ambitious goals.

Furthermore You Bring

8+ years of project management experience within large, complex IT or transformation programmes.
Experience in banking, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
Proven track record of leading migration, modernization, or core banking transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
Experience managing risks, dependencies, budgets, and senior-level governance.
Good understanding of modern software delivery practices and AI-enabled ways of working.
Experience with core banking platforms and COBOL modernization programmes.
Knowledge of lending products and banking operations.
Experience with data migration and Agile delivery at scale (SAFe).
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Services, or similar AI-supported delivery tools.

Rewards And Benefits

We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.

The Benefits Of Working With Us At ING Include

An attractive gross salary, depending on your job category and professional experience.
Flex Budget
20 statutory holidays, plus an additional 9–11 days of annual leave, 1 regional public holiday, and 4 bank holidays
Profit Sharing

Telephone subscription and internet allowance

Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

This is an opportunity to play a key role in one of the largest transformation programmes within the organization. new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in New Orleans, LA; Houston, TX; or Baton Rouge, LA.

The candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the region and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

This Opportunity

Provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the delivery of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation infrastructure, in accordance with WSP’s core values, established project management methodologies, and the contractual scope of services agreed upon with utility and energy sector clients. Responsible for the overall performance of assigned Power Delivery projects of moderate size and complexity and/or local to regional scope, including oversight of project financials, budgets, forecasting, earned value, schedules (CPM), technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), health and safety, and risk management. Ensures full adherence to responsibilities across the end‑to‑end project lifecycle—including proposal development, project startup and planning, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, reporting, and project closeout—with deliverables documented, governed, and audited to meet or exceed corporate standards for safety, execution excellence, profitability, regulatory compliance, and operational performance within a Power Delivery and utility infrastructure environment.

Your Impact

Oversee and lead cross‑functional Power Delivery project teams (engineering, design, construction, project controls, and support staff) to execute mid‑level and concurrent transmission, distribution, and substation projects, including management of project budgets, hours and expenses, labor and material quantities, equipment costs, deliverables, compliance documentation, and contractual obligations in accordance with utility, EPC, and client contracts.
Contribute to the development of Power Delivery project proposals, including cost estimates, scopes of work, schedules (CPM), execution strategies, and resource plans supporting utility capital programs.
Develop and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), task sequencing, and cost-loaded estimates to support schedule control, forecasting, and earned value management (EVM).
Establish and enforce the appropriate level of technical, constructability, and design reviews, selecting qualified engineering and discipline leads, and ensuring compliance with QA/QC programs, utility standards, and WSP quality plans
Support margin analysis, profitability forecasting, and contingency planning, establishing margin targets, risk allowances, and mitigation strategies across assigned Power Delivery projects or portfolios.
Coordinate and assist with the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, scope alignment, client presentations, and execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Develop, maintain, and update Project Initiation and governance documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Project Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans, in accordance with WSP and client requirements.
Participate in and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to confirm roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Collaborate closely with Project Accounting and Finance teams to monitor project performance metrics, including estimated time‑to‑completion, cash flow, invoicing, accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, and budgeted margin for individual projects or Power Delivery portfolios.
Oversee project controls functions, including budgeting, forecasting, CPM scheduling, cost control, change management, and risk management, ensuring alignment with project execution plans.

new_jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Manager — IT / Digital Delivery
Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE

ROLE SUMMARY:
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of technology and digital projects. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams — translating business objectives into deliverable plans, running the Agile ceremonies that keep delivery moving, removing impediments, and holding delivery to scope, schedule, budget, and quality commitments. You will provide regular, clear and credible reporting to senior and executive management, and manage risks, issues, dependencies, and third-party vendors across the project lifecycle. Working knowledge of trading and capital markets is essential for this role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Project Delivery & Governance
* Own project delivery end to end — initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control and closure — for one or more concurrent technology projects.
* Define the project charter: scope, objectives, deliverables, success criteria, assumptions, constraints and governance model.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestone schedules, dependency maps and critical path analysis.
* Manage project budgets: cost estimation, forecasting, actuals tracking, variance analysis, purchase orders and invoice validation.
* Manage resource plans and capacity across internal teams, contractors and vendors.
* Operate formal change control — assess and document the impact of scope changes on cost, schedule, quality and risk, and secure the appropriate approvals.
* Ensure compliance with PMO standards, SDLC governance, information-security requirements, internal audit and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Maintain complete and auditable project documentation and artefacts.
Risk, Issue & Dependency Management
* Maintain and actively work the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies).
* Identify risks early, quantify impact and probability, define mitigation and contingency plans, and assign clear ownership.
* Resolve issues at the lowest effective level and escalate promptly and factually when resolution is beyond the project's authority.
* Manage cross-project and cross-team dependencies, including infrastructure, security, data, operations and external parties.
Stakeholder Management & Communication
* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work with business stakeholders, business analysts and product owners to elicit, challenge and prioritise requirements, and confirm that the delivered solution meets the stated business need.
* Chair steering committees and project boards; prepare and present decision papers and options analyses.
* Provide regular, accurate status reporting to upper management and executives — progress against plan, budget position, risks, issues, decisions required and forecast completion.
* Build and maintain executive dashboards and reporting packs; tailor the level of detail to the audience.
* Manage expectations and negotiate trade-offs across scope, time, cost and quality with credibility and transparency.
* Manage vendors and third parties: statements of work, deliverable acceptance, service levels, performance reviews and commercial escalation.
Agile Delivery
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies with the delivery team: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
* Work with product owners to keep the backlog healthy — well-formed stories, clear acceptance criteria, correct prioritisation and readiness for sprint.
* Track and report delivery metrics: velocity, burndown and burnup, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and release predictability.
* Identify and remove impediments blocking the team; protect the team from unmanaged scope change and disruption.
* Coach the team and the wider business on Agile practices, and operate hybrid Agile/waterfall approaches where the project or regulatory context requires it.
* Drive continuous improvement from retrospective actions and lessons learned.
Quality, Release & Transition
* Coordinate test planning and execution across system, integration, performance, security and user acceptance testing.
* Manage UAT with business stakeholders, including defect triage, prioritisation and sign-off.
* Plan and coordinate releases: cutover plans, rollback plans, go/no-go criteria and production readiness reviews.
* Manage business readiness — training, communications, process changes and organisational change impacts.
* Ensure a clean transition to support operations, including documentation, handover and hypercare.
* Run post-implementation reviews, capture lessons learned and track benefits realisation against the business case.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:
* Minimum 8 years of project management experience delivering IT, software and digital projects end to end, including at least 3 years in an Agile delivery environment.
* Proven track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards.
* Strong command of both Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and traditional/hybrid delivery methodologies (waterfall, stage-gate).
* Demonstrated ability to run Agile ceremonies effectively and coach teams in Agile practice.
* Strong planning and scheduling skills including work breakdown structures, estimation techniques, dependency management and critical path analysis.
* Budget, cost control, resource planning and vendor/contract management experience.
* Rigorous risk, issue, dependency and change management discipline.
* Excellent executive communication, reporting and presentation skills; able to distil complex technical detail into clear business language.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills across all levels of an organisation.
* Sufficient technical literacy to engage credibly with engineering teams — SDLC, APIs and integrations, cloud, web and mobile applications, data and reporting, testing, environments and release management — and to challenge estimates, designs and risk assessments.
* Requirements and business-analysis fundamentals: process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability.
* Hands-on proficiency with project and collaboration tooling such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, SharePoint and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint for analysis and executive reporting.
* Working knowledge of trading and capital markets is essential — including the trade lifecycle (order origination, routing, execution, clearing and settlement), market data, brokerage and exchange operations, post-trade processes, and the regulatory and compliance environment in which they operate.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

PREFERRED / ADVANTAGEOUS:
* Professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or SAFe.
* Arabic language proficiency (spoken and written) — preferred.
* Experience delivering projects for an exchange, brokerage, bank, asset manager or fintech.
* Experience managing regulatory, compliance-driven or audited technology programmes.
* Experience managing systems integrators and offshore or distributed delivery teams.
* Formal change-management training (for example Prosci / ADKAR).
* Experience with ITIL service transition, or with programme-level or portfolio-level delivery.
* Experience introducing or improving PMO processes, templates and delivery governance.

QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Overview

Job Description

Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) is a key portfolio within the Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS), that brings payment solutions and associated services to clients around the globe. Our global clients and partners deploy our solutions to serve the needs of Small Businesses, Middle Market Clients, Large Corporate Clients, Multi Nationals, Treasury, and Governments. We work closely with Issuers, Merchants, FinTechs and other ecosystem players to deliver these services. VCS is the business unit responsible for growing all flows between businesses and governments from SMBs to the largest global corporates. The VCS PMO team has responsibility for supporting the Virtual & Payables, Data Solutions, Small Business and Large, Mid-Market verticals’ product strategy of VCS. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations & Infrastructure, Cyber-Security, Client services, and key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.

Technical Program Manager for Visa Commercial Solutions will provide oversight and governance on delivery of all product and technology initiatives as well as collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure seamless and timely planning, prioritization and execution. This role is critical for a successful delivery of the FY26 and beyond objectives and milestones for the product & technology roadmap.

VCS Technical Program managers are highly influential and impactful leaders, building bridges & tunnels across Visa to ensure that our initiatives are effectively conceived, elaborated, prioritized, designed, developed, tested, integrated, and deployed with quality and on time delivery into our production systems and released to our end users. The ideal candidate will have a solid experience with cross-functional team leadership, technology/product program management, release management, Lean-Agile methodologies, cross-functional team leadership, as well as superb skills in communications, data analysis, problem-solving, cross-team coordination, governance, and change management. The ideal candidate is not just a facilitator or project plan tracker but ensures that things get done. The person should display a drive to get things done, possess a can-do attitude, a growth-oriented mindset, a process-focus and an ability to deal with ambiguity. Candidates need to be technology literate and be willing to learn new technologies, optimize processes, implement efficiencies and to multi-task, and manage through influence, complex and matrixed collaboration, data analysis, problem-solving, process & data-driven decision making, change management and communication across global time zones.

Essential Functions

Partner with the Product & Technology leads to drive and ensure effective Quarterly Execution Planning (QEP) leveraging Jira Align as the Single Source of Truth.
Help and facilitate prioritization of Epics and features that align to the program Objectives & Key Results (OKRs) and available workforce capacity.
Manage program financials with respect to budget, forecast & actuals for labor capital/expenses and Infrastructure costs, develop budgets, and produce documentation needed for funding Approvals to Spend (ATS).
Ensure effective preparation and participation of Team of Teams (TofT) in the Quarterly Execution Planning (QEP) activities across programs, collaborating with partners in Operations & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other Visa Technology verticals.
Ensure that the program and projects follow Visa's Agile Management Methodology (AM2) and Key Controls, and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status.
Act as a coach to the scrum teams on adopting agile best practices. Be the leader in advancing the ongoing transformation to Visa’s Agility Practices and Agile Management methodology (AM2).
Learn and adopt Visa’s Secure Software Development Lifecycle Management (SSDLC), Golden Rules, release management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes.
Leverage and actively use Gen AI tools for PLM and SDLC enablement
Provide quality, flow, and value metrics-based reporting to all stakeholders, hold regular program-level ceremonies (Scrum of Scrums, Agile Release Train Sync, System Demos).
Cultivate a mindset of rigorous planning & prioritizing while proactively identifying risks and dependencies to accelerate value realization.
Manage cross-functional communications to maximize understanding, impact, and speed of change adoption.
Capture metrics & measurables that clearly indicate progress toward accomplishment of program and business unit OKRs.
Develop a rigor for understanding and leveraging the quality, flow, and value-based metrics to accelerate benefit realization.
Generate and improve the agility metrics (performance, predictability, and persistency) by optimizing and governing the Visa processes for planning, budgeting, prioritization, delivery, release management, workforce planning and stakeholder (ELT, SLT) reporting.
Assist and support with External (FFIEC) & Internal audits on the program. Ensure that all programs supported by the PMO adhere to always audit compliant processes.
Ensure that identified security vulnerabilities are addressed and remediated in a timely manner to prevent non-compliance. Ensure that exceptions are obtained in a timely manner and kept to a minimum.
Volunteer for additional responsibilities related to Visa processes, cross-functional project governance and hiring of team members and participate in required fire drills.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Agile Lifecycle Management tool (Jira, Jira Align, Rally) and PPM (Clarity, Primavera, HP PPM etc.).
Scaled Agile Certification (SAFe for Teams, Leading SAFe, Implementing SAFe, SAFe for Release Train Engineers).
Experience with project management and reporting tools (e.g., Clarity, Rally, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, JIRA Etc.)
Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc
Program management professional (PgMP) and/or Project Management Professional (PMP).
Experience with JIRA Align, Tableau, Power BI.
Experience with project management techniques software development lifecycle in a Fin-Tech background scrum or agile experience.
Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc.
Experience with Gen AI tools for PLM and SDLC enablement learning to improve. effectiveness of the Product delivery.

Information for US Applicants

Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in New Orleans, LA; Houston, TX; or Baton Rouge, LA.

The candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the region and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

This Opportunity

Provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the delivery of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation infrastructure, in accordance with WSP’s core values, established project management methodologies, and the contractual scope of services agreed upon with utility and energy sector clients. Responsible for the overall performance of assigned Power Delivery projects of moderate size and complexity and/or local to regional scope, including oversight of project financials, budgets, forecasting, earned value, schedules (CPM), technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), health and safety, and risk management. Ensures full adherence to responsibilities across the end‑to‑end project lifecycle—including proposal development, project startup and planning, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, reporting, and project closeout—with deliverables documented, governed, and audited to meet or exceed corporate standards for safety, execution excellence, profitability, regulatory compliance, and operational performance within a Power Delivery and utility infrastructure environment.

Your Impact

Oversee and lead cross‑functional Power Delivery project teams (engineering, design, construction, project controls, and support staff) to execute mid‑level and concurrent transmission, distribution, and substation projects, including management of project budgets, hours and expenses, labor and material quantities, equipment costs, deliverables, compliance documentation, and contractual obligations in accordance with utility, EPC, and client contracts.
Contribute to the development of Power Delivery project proposals, including cost estimates, scopes of work, schedules (CPM), execution strategies, and resource plans supporting utility capital programs.
Develop and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), task sequencing, and cost-loaded estimates to support schedule control, forecasting, and earned value management (EVM).
Establish and enforce the appropriate level of technical, constructability, and design reviews, selecting qualified engineering and discipline leads, and ensuring compliance with QA/QC programs, utility standards, and WSP quality plans
Support margin analysis, profitability forecasting, and contingency planning, establishing margin targets, risk allowances, and mitigation strategies across assigned Power Delivery projects or portfolios.
Coordinate and assist with the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, scope alignment, client presentations, and execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Develop, maintain, and update Project Initiation and governance documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Project Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans, in accordance with WSP and client requirements.
Participate in and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to confirm roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Collaborate closely with Project Accounting and Finance teams to monitor project performance metrics, including estimated time‑to‑completion, cash flow, invoicing, accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, and budgeted margin for individual projects or Power Delivery portfolios.
Oversee project controls functions, including budgeting, forecasting, CPM scheduling, cost control, change management, and risk management, ensuring alignment with project execution plans.
Coordinate with area, technical, and resource managers to address staffing, specialty expertise, subcontracting, and vendor support needs in a timely manner across Power Delivery projects.
Proactively identify, communicate, and escalate Health & Safety incidents, regulatory issues, and significant client concerns to senior project management and leadership, in accordance with WSP safety and governance requirements.
Participate in and support problem project and recovery reviews, providing root‑cause analysis, corrective action recommendations, and recovery planning input to leadership and stakeholders.
Provide regular, structured project reporting to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, identifying emerging risks, scope changes, schedule impacts, and budget variances.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, and cash flow, coordinating corrective actions with project accounting, finance, and client teams as needed.
Coordinate with Procurement and Supply Chain teams to support purchase order closeout, vendor performance, and supplier agreement completion. [
Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain current knowledge of project management methodologies, PMAP standards, utility delivery practices, and Power Delivery industry trends.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, project risks, client commitments, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C firm, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
7–10 years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.
Sound understanding of the project delivery lifecycle within the A/E/C and utility industries, including proposal development, project initiation, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, commissioning, and project closeout, with a well‑defined background in Power Delivery project management.
Well‑developed analytical, organizational, and project controls skills, with demonstrated business and commercial acumen to bridge financial performance, risk management, and technical execution.
Competent critical thinking and problem‑solving skills, including the ability to apply project management principles, schedule and cost analysis, forecasting, and risk‑based decision‑making to achieve optimal Power Delivery project outcomes
Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and persuasively with utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal leadership.
Demonstrated self‑leadership and accountability, with strong attention to detail, quality, multitasking, and adaptability in a dynamic Power Delivery and utility project environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight, while providing technical guidance and leadership to junior project managers, engineers, and support staff, with strict adherence to QA/QC, safety, and delivery standards.
Competency in technical writing, project documentation, office automation, and project management software, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), scheduling tools, and Power Delivery PM platforms.
Demonstrated effectiveness coordinating project resources and directing consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, and vendors, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant execution of Power Delivery project tasks.
Proven commitment to workplace health, safety, and environmental compliance, including adherence to WSP health and safety programs, drug/alcohol policies, and harassment‑free workplace standards.
Ability to support project‑driven schedules, including extended hours or outage‑related work periods, as required for utility and Power Delivery projects.
Willingness and ability to perform occasional travel to support client engagement, project sites, and regional Power Delivery initiatives

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Essential project management certification required (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Vehicle Service Readiness & Product Integration
new_jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

The Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM), Vehicle Service Readiness & Product Integration, is a systems-integration role responsible for service requirements integration, validation, and lifecycle service readiness across Rivian's active and future vehicle platforms, including R1, EDV, and R2. This role serves as the primary bridge between Product Development (PD) and the Service Operations functions responsible for service engineering, diagnostics, and tooling.

Operating with a high degree of initiative, independent judgment, and indirect leadership, the Staff TPM is accountable for gathering, analyzing, and integrating hardware, software, service tooling, and other service-related requirements into a consolidated service position and driving that position into the Product Development process — ensuring that service parts, service manuals, diagnostic frameworks, and service tooling are 100% mature and deployed by vehicle launch. Beyond individual program execution, the Staff TPM sets the standards and governance frameworks other TPMs use to integrate requirements, serves as the escalation point for the most complex and/or ambiguous cross-functional trade-offs before they reach the Sr. Manager or Director level, and mentors peer TPMs to raise technical and program rigor across the team.

The Staff Technical Program Manager, Vehicle Service Readiness & Product Integration will be expected to report in a hybrid capacity to our Irvine, CA office and report to our Sr. Manager, Vehicle Service Readiness & Product Integration.

Responsibilities

Service Requirements Integration & Governance
Lead regular technical reviews with Service Engineering, Diagnostic Engineering, and Service Tooling subject matter experts to gather, analyze, and integrate hardware, software, service tooling, and other service-related requirements into a consolidated service position, across multiple concurrent vehicle platforms.
Translate combined serviceability constraints into clear Service Design Targets tied directly to vehicle program milestones, and establish the standards and playbooks other platform TPMs use to do the same.
Present a unified service requirements position to Product Development, Vehicle Line Directors, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring Service Operations maintains a cohesive and consistent stance within the development process.
Drive requirements into Flow, CAD reviews, and related engineering forums before every iteration of design freeze to reduce fragmented communication and protect program timing.
Establish best practices and standards of work for service requirements integration across the TPM function.
Service Parts Strategy Identification & Consolidation
Partner with Service Engineering and Design Release Engineers (DREs) to drive the "BOM scraping" processes during early vehicle program milestones, identify newly designed components and assemblies, and determine component-level service parts.
Integrate the Service New Product Introduction (SNPI) team early into the vehicle program to map out comprehensive lifecycle strategies for identified parts.
Drive the milestones for the formal creation and release of the Service Bill of Materials (SBOM) and labor codes structure across assigned and adjacent platforms.
Support the execution of Service Parts Change Management to ensure that SNPI and logistics teams utilize clean released service data to construct the forecast for distribution centers.
Validation and Readiness Execution
Own end-to-end validation of consolidated service targets and requirements across both virtual and physical development stages for the most complex and/or highest-risk assigned vehicle programs.
Lead virtual CAD reviews and digital packaging assessments within CATIA to verify service access, clearance, and labor time expectations.
Manage physical serviceability validation programs for engineering and manufacturing builds, encompassing asset allocation, mechanical teardowns, service tooling trials, time studies, and high-voltage electrical safety compliance.
Ensure physical builds validate the requirements established during the virtual phase and support milestone signoff readiness, serving as the final technical checkpoint before leadership sign-off.
Align physical teardown validation results with Technical Writing teams to gate the formal release of step-by-step Service Manual procedures and localized torque specifications.
Track the end-to-end service tooling release lifecycle from prototype to production signoff with the Service Tooling Team, ensuring specialized field tools are validated on physical builds and ready for manufacturing deployment.
Cross-Functional Risk Mitigation & Technical Escalation
Serve as the escalation point for peer TPMs on the most complex technical trade-offs across packaging, diagnostics, tooling, and mechanical access before they impact downstream timing or require Sr. Manager/Director escalation.
Identify, document, and escalate design non-compliance through Virtual Service Issues and other tracking mechanisms when service requirements are not being met.
Build early alignment across stakeholders to reduce downstream Engineering Change Requests, part deviations, and late-stage launch risk, and drive cross-platform standards to eliminate recurring classes of risk.
Represent Vehicle Service Readiness & Product Integration in executive and cross-functional program reviews.
Milestone Execution and Change Management
Own execution of Product Development Service Functional Overlay milestones for assigned vehicle programs, including the most schedule-critical and/or technically ambiguous programs.
Use the RDP Service Functional Overlay to track alignment between defined service requirements and current CAD maturity, and drive continuous improvement of the tracking dashboards and processes used across the TPM team.
Track, triage, and evaluate service-impacting changes with clear ownership, service strategy, and next steps.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other TPMs on requirements integration, validation methodology, and change governance.

Key Performance Indicators

100 percent on-time completion of RDP Service Functional Overlay milestones for assigned vehicle programs
Effective tracking, management, and triage of service-impacting change drivers across assigned and supported platforms
Strong technical integration efficiency in resolving tradeoffs and delivering unified service positions into Product Development and Engineering Systems
Early adoption and validation of serviceability requirements across virtual and physical development stages
Reduction in escalations reaching Sr. Manager/Director level through proactive standards-setting and peer mentorship

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Master's degree preferred
6 to 10+ years of experience in technical program management, systems engineering, automotive launch operations, or a related field, preferably within the EV sector
Demonstrated success influencing matrixed cross-functional stakeholders in high-velocity, high-stress product development or launch environments, including at the Director and Vehicle Line level
Proven ability to operate with a high degree of initiative, independent judgment, and indirect leadership capability
Proven ability to negotiate technical tradeoffs, drive accountability, and build alignment without direct authority, including mentoring or informally guiding peer TPMs
Strong conceptual understanding of EV vehicle architectures, high-voltage battery systems, software configuration management, diagnostics, and design-for-serviceability standards
Familiarity with CATIA or equivalent CAD and PLM systems, including the ability to review complex design geometry in support of serviceability assessments
Strong skills in JIRA/Confluence, Flow, and dashboard creation

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $154,000 to $192,500 for Irvine, CA based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Plan if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than October 17, 2026.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long-term market trajectory. At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.

If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.

Job Description

The Senior QA/DV Program Manager a highly skilled and driven Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution, delivery, and quality assurance of multiple ASIC SOC hardware and BMC software solutions portfolios. System-Level QA Strategy: Oversee the testing schedule for full server systems and BMC boards hosting the SOC.

Automation & Infrastructure: Track the deployment of automated test regressions running on physical server infrastructure.

DV Program Focus

Milestone Tracking & Delivery: Drive schedule adherence for block-level, subsystem, and full-chip verification milestones.

Qualifications
